lines.t: Mm… yeah…
I see it now…
What walks with them… Don’t walk with it…
Jealous eyes never satisfied
Looking out while they hide inside
Craving what was never their own
Empty hearts dressed up as gold
Quiet thoughts start taking root
Twisting what was once the truth
It don’t stand, it slowly consumes
That’s the path of the companion of fools
Don’t follow where it leads
See the chain behind the greed
What looks small begins to grow
Till it takes control of the soul
Companion of fools, let it fall
Jealous fire, reject it all
Hand in hand with a restless need
Covet ties wants what it sees
Step away…
(step away!)
Don’t walk in that crooked way
Don’t walk in that crooked way
Truth in light is calling through
Don’t stand with the blinded few
Companion… companion… fools
Counting what another gains
While their own slips through the same
Linked together, envy and want
Pulling hearts till they’re undone
What they chase will leave them bare
Nothing living can be found there
Cut it off before it stays
Before it shapes your inner ways
Guard the heart, don’t let it in
That’s where all these paths begin
Companion of fools…
Companion of fools…
Companion of fools, let it fall
Companion of fools, let it fall
Jealous fire, reject it all
Hand in hand with a restless need
Covet ties wants what it sees
Step away…
(Step away!)
Don’t walk in that crooked way
Don’t walk in that crooked way
Truth in light is calling through
Don’t stand with the blinded few
Two walk close but they bring decay
Jealousy leads the heart astray
What you feed will grow inside
Choose the truth, don’t let it hide
Let it go… let it die…
Every hidden, watching eye
Turn away… make it clean…
Not everything is what it seems
Companion of fools
Companion of fools
Jealous chains, be set free
Covet paths, refuse to choose
Don’t walk as the blinded do
Companion of fools, be set apart
Truth alive inside your heart
Light revealed, now see it through
Yeah…
Jealousy fades where truth remains…
